# Inventory

# Products: Inventory Management

This documentation outlines the setup and management of inventory within the Pixfizz ecosystem, detailing how stock levels, locations, and fulfillment rules interact between **Pixfizz Core**, **Pixfizz Online**, and **OrderHub**.

---

## 1. Initial Inventory Setup
To track inventory, the feature must first be enabled within **Pixfizz Core**. 

*   **The Inventory Flag:** Inventory tracking will not function unless this specific flag is enabled in the Core settings.
*   **Product Synchronization:** Once enabled, products are synchronized to the storefront as **static products** with the inventory flag active.

---

## 2. Locations, Stock, and Suppliers
Inventory management complexity scales based on your brand's physical footprint.

### Stock Management
For every item in the system, you can track:
*   **On-hand Quantity:** The physical count per location.
*   **Reorder Level:** An optional threshold that triggers reporting to prevent stockouts.

![Setting Inventory Levels](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/4486c39d-b3b3-4b44-a86d-3f96f4bb4a50.png)

### Supplier Integration
Multiple suppliers can be linked to a single product to optimize procurement.

| Feature | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Base Pricing** | The standard cost per unit from the specific supplier. |
| **Lead Times** | The expected duration for stock to arrive. |
| **Supplier Codes** | Unique identifiers used for ordering from specific vendors. |
| **Rush Orders** | System logic identifies which supplier can fulfill stock needs within a specific number of working days. |

![Assigning suppliers to inventory products](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/13702ec1-f70c-450d-8766-156fc4f12b27.png)

---

## 3. Handling Multiple Locations
When operating across multiple sites, the system must be configured to handle online order routing and stock replenishment.

*   **Order Forwarding:** Online orders are typically routed to a specific primary location.
*   **Stock Replenishment:** If the primary location is low, stock may need to be transferred from secondary locations.
*   **Master System Logic:** **OrderHub** acts as the "Master System." 
    *   While an online order instantly decrements stock in the online store, OrderHub will eventually overwrite that value with the true count.
    *   This ensures that Point of Sale (POS) transactions occurring in-store are accounted for, preventing the online store from **overselling** out-of-stock items.

---

## 4. Setting Fulfilment Rules
Users must define how stock availability is calculated and reported to the online storefront. These settings are found under **Settings > Inventory**.

### Fulfilment Models

| Model | Description | Best For |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Single Location** | Fulfil and synchronise from one primary location only (Single-source mirror). | Brands with one main warehouse or localized fulfillment. |
| **Sum Across All Locations** | Aggregates inventory across every location and reports the total as available stock. | Brands with distributed inventory looking to maximize online availability. |

---

## Key Inventory Summary Points

*   **Master Control:** **OrderHub** is the authoritative source for stock levels to ensure POS and Online sales remain synchronized.
*   **Mandatory Flag:** Inventory tracking is **disabled by default**; it must be toggled in Pixfizz Core to function.
*   **Supplier Flexibility:** Attaching multiple suppliers allows for **Lead Time** optimization during rush periods.
*   **Oversell Protection:** The system uses real-time synchronization to ensure online availability matches physical on-hand quantities across your chosen locations.
